Get in touch

Contact us

If you are ready to lodge, the client portal is faster than an email — it asks the questions we would ask anyway. For anything else, here we are.

Phone

Monday to Friday 8am–9pm, Saturday and Sunday 10am–9pm.

Email

New enquiries. We reply within one business day.

support@xyzaccounting.com.au

Existing clients and portal help.

Postal address

Attention BRS Advisory
GPO Box 2440
Adelaide SA 5001

Mail only. We are an online practice and don’t see clients at the office.

Send us a message

For anything that isn’t starting a return. If you are ready to lodge, the client portal asks the questions we would ask anyway and is faster.

Form not loading? Open it in a new tab, or just email us — the address is above. Please don’t include your tax file number either way; we ask for it securely once an accountant is working on your return.

Please do not email us your tax file number

Email is not a secure channel and TFNs are subject to the Privacy (Tax File Number) Rule 2015. We never ask for one on this website, and we collect it through a secure channel once an accountant is working on your return. If you have already emailed one, tell us and we will remove it.

What to have ready when you call

Nothing, if it is a first conversation. If you are mid-return, having your income statement and the figure the calculator gave you makes the call about five minutes shorter.

Complaints

If something has gone wrong, email us at support@xyzaccounting.com.au.
